# Cora — Style Reference

> gouache sky behind a white stamp border, one cobalt pill for postage. Light Signifier serif drifts over painted clouds, small black Switzer sits on white cards, hairlines are frosted white, and cobalt appears only at the frame and trial pill.

**Theme:** dark

Values are measured from the live site and normalized; names, roles and recommendations are interpretation. Font lists are independent, not paired by position. Example prompts describe reconstructions, not the site's source code.

Cora speaks a painted-sky correspondence language. The canvas is not a color but a hand-painted gouache sky of clouds and autumn trees, held inside a #117bc8 cobalt margin and a white border, so the page reads as a framed picture rather than a web surface. Three opaque layers sit above the painting: #f2f6fc for the testimonial band, #ffffff for cards and the hero pill, and #ffffffe5 frosted glass for the nav cluster. The chromatic budget is exactly one system hue, #117bc8, permitted only on the outer frame and the filled trial pill. Every green, ochre and sky tone lives inside the illustration and stays out of the token set. Type splits by family rather than weight. Signifier at 300 and 400 with zero tracking handles every headline from 34px to 55px, while Switzer runs at 12px weight 500 on 160 elements, a 4.6x jump that lets the change of family carry the hierarchy. Shapes are 9999px pills and 12px cards lifted by a 7%-black, 10px-blur shadow. The result reads as a picture book about email rather than an inbox dashboard.

## Tokens — Colors

| Name | Value | Token | Role |
|---|---|---|---|
| Lapis Frame | `#117bc8` | `--color-lapis-frame` | Body background behind the framed painting and the fixed nav's "Start free trial" fill. It has only 2 background uses, yet it owns every viewport edge — it is the brand's whole chromatic budget. Do not spread it into cards, headings or icons. |
| Cloud Paper | `#ffffff` | `--color-cloud-paper` | Testimonial cards, the hero pill, the white frame border and every headline set over the sky. With 100 background and 72 text uses, it works as both surface and reverse ink. |
| Cloud Glass | `#ffffffe5` | `--color-cloud-glass` | The fixed nav pill cluster holding Log in and the trial button — 90% white leaves the painting faintly present under navigation without a hard plate. |
| Mist Band | `#f2f6fc` | `--color-mist-band` | The full-width testimonial marquee band beneath the hero and the cloudbank that fades into it — a blue-tinted white that lets painted clouds dissolve without a seam. |
| Fog Track | `#ebebeb` | `--color-fog-track` | Inner row dividers and quiet fills on white product fragments — one step below Cloud Paper, so tiny controls separate without drawn borders. |
| Ink | `#000000` | `--color-ink` | Testimonial quotes, the nav "Log in" label and the selected billing-toggle label, 248 uses in all — always on white, so the system's darkest value is confined to paper. Keep it off the painted sky. |
| Graphite Text | `#2b2b2b` | `--color-graphite-text` | Subject lines and dense secondary copy on white product fragments, 7 uses — it softens 12px rows that pure Ink would make heavy. |
| Pewter Caption | `#7d7d7d` | `--color-pewter-caption` | Testimonial job titles, timestamps and metadata, 9 uses — the only gray that carries readable copy. Do not set it on the blue sky, where it fails contrast. |
| Ash Caption | `#a1a1a1` | `--color-ash-caption` | Placeholder and disabled micro-labels inside product mockups, 2 uses — the faintest readable step, reserved for content meant to recede. |
| Pebble Bezel | `#dadada` | `--color-pebble-bezel` | The 5px rim around the hero device mockup — an opaque gray bezel that turns a flat screenshot into a physical object resting in the sky. |
| Frost Ring | `#ffffff60` | `--color-frost-ring` | The 2px border on every glass CTA pill, 4 uses — a 38% white edge that outlines the button against painted backgrounds of any tone. |
| Frost Hairline | `#ffffff15` | `--color-frost-hairline` | 1px dividers between FAQ rows and rules over blue, 12 uses — the most frequent border, an 8% white hairline that whispers rather than draws. |
| Smoke Glass | `#00000010` | `--color-smoke-glass` | The fill of glass CTA pills under a 20px backdrop blur, 4 uses — 6% black darkens the painting just enough for white labels. Do not raise its opacity into a solid button. |

## Tokens — Typography

### Signifier — the display serif that does all headline work at light and regular weights · `--font-signifier`

- **Substitute:** Newsreader at 350, EB Garamond at 400, Source Serif 4 at 300. Signifier draws slightly heavier than its nominal weight: its Light 300 at 55px reads closer to a 350 because the stems are sturdier than the hairlines suggest. EB Garamond draws thin and must move up to 400. Source Serif 4 is already sturdy and stays at 300.
- **Weights:** 300, 400
- **Sizes:** 24px, 34px, 36px, 45px, 55px
- **Line height:** 1.02, 1.18, 1.2
- **Letter spacing:** 0px at 24px, 0px at 34px, 0px at 36px, 0px at 45px, 0px at 55px
- **Role:** A literary serif at weight 300 on the hero is anti-convention for an AI product, a category that defaults to heavy geometric sans. Here the headline reads as a printed letter, not a pitch. The feature heads use a 1.02 line height at 34px, which is deliberately tight and stacks two-line heads into a solid block. The steps of 34, 45 and 55 move by about 1.3 and 1.22, roughly Perfect Fourth followed by Minor Third. Zero tracking at every size trusts the face's own spacing instead of the negative tracking typical of SaaS display type.

### Switzer — the neo-grotesk that runs every quote, label and button at small sizes · `--font-switzer`

- **Substitute:** Inter at 500, Geist at 500, Manrope at 500. Switzer is free on Fontshare and should be used directly where possible. It renders true to its nominal weight, so match weights one-to-one. Manrope draws marginally lighter, so step any Switzer 400 up to Manrope 500 rather than going down.
- **Weights:** 400, 500, 600, 700
- **Sizes:** 12px, 14px, 15px, 16px, 17px, 18px, 20px, 22px
- **Line height:** 1.0, 1.02, 1.2, 1.24
- **Letter spacing:** 0px at 12px, 0px at 14px, 0px at 15px, 0px at 16px, 0px at 17px, 0px at 18px, 0px at 20px, 0px at 22px
- **Role:** Switzer is the workhorse: 160 of its 332 measured uses are 12px at weight 500, and another 80 are 12px at weight 700 for names. That makes this an unusually small body voice, sized like a letter's marginalia. Weight separates name from quote inside a card, while family separates content from headline across the page. The 1.24 ratio repeats at 12px, 14px, 18px and 22px, which shows a single line-height rule applied everywhere instead of a tuned per-size scale.

### Type Scale

| Role | Family | Weight | Size | Line Height | Letter Spacing | Token |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| small | Switzer | 500 | 12px | 1.24 | 0px | `--text-small` |
| caption | Switzer | 600 | 14px | 1.24 | 0px | `--text-caption` |
| body-sm | Switzer | 400 | 15px | 1.24 | 0px | `--text-body-sm` |
| body | Switzer | 500 | 17px | 1.2 | 0px | `--text-body` |
| body-lg | Switzer | 400 | 18px | 1.24 | 0px | `--text-body-lg` |
| subheading | Switzer | 400 | 20px | 1.0 | 0px | `--text-subheading` |
| heading-sm | Switzer | 600 | 22px | 1.24 | 0px | `--text-heading-sm` |
| heading | Signifier | 400 | 34px | 1.02 | 0px | `--text-heading` |
| heading-lg | Signifier | 400 | 45px | 1.02 | 0px | `--text-heading-lg` |
| display | Signifier | 300 | 55px | 1.18 | 0px | `--text-display` |

## Do's and Don'ts

### Do

- Let the painted sky be the canvas and frame it with a #117bc8 margin and a white border — the picture-in-a-frame structure is the thesis.
- Set every headline in Signifier at weight 300 or 400 with 0px tracking, 34px to 55px — quiet serif headlines are what separate Cora from bold-sans AI tools.
- Keep body and card copy in Switzer at 12px weight 500 with a 1.24 line height — small type makes the illustration the loudest element.
- Spend #117bc8 on exactly one filled control, the 9999px trial pill with a 2px #ffffff ring — this rationing is non-negotiable.
- Use #00000010 glass with a 20px blur and a 2px #ffffff60 border for every CTA placed over paint — the edge survives any background tone.
- Lift white cards with `0px 4px 10px 0px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.07)` at 12px radius — the shadow should read as paper resting, not floating.
- Separate sections with 108px of uninterrupted painting — the gap is where the illustration does its storytelling.

### Don't

- Don't set headlines in Switzer at weight 700 — a bold sans at 55px turns the letter into a SaaS banner and erases the serif thesis.
- Don't introduce a second accent such as a green taken from the trees — the budget is one hue, and painted colors are never tokens.
- Don't put #000000 or #7d7d7d text directly on the sky — Ink and Pewter belong on #ffffff, and on blue they fail contrast.
- Don't wrap feature copy in an opaque #ffffff panel — the 34px white serif sitting directly on paint is the composition.
- Don't square the CTAs to 8px radius — every action is a 9999px pill, and corners would read as form fields.
- Don't replace the 1px #ffffff15 FAQ rules with gray boxes — conventional accordion chrome adds plates the sky cannot absorb.
- Don't tighten Signifier with -0.02em tracking at 55px — negative tracking is a tech-display habit that compresses the letterpress spacing.

## Agent Prompt Guide

**Quick Color Reference**
- frame / page edge: #117bc8 (Lapis Frame)
- card surface: #ffffff (Cloud Paper)
- light band: #f2f6fc (Mist Band)
- text on white: #000000 (Ink)
- caption on white: #7d7d7d (Pewter Caption)
- hairline over blue: #ffffff15 (Frost Hairline)
- primary action: #117bc8 (filled action)

**Color in Data**
Charts sit on #ffffff and use #000000 and #7d7d7d bars, and only the single highlighted series takes #117bc8 at 40% opacity, so data never outshouts the trial pill.

**Example Component Prompts**

1. Build a primary action button: an anchor with background #117bc8, text #ffffff, a 2px solid #ffffff border, border-radius 9999px, padding 8px 23px and height 40px. Set the label "Start free trial" in Switzer at 20px, weight 400, line-height 1.0, letter-spacing 0px, with no shadow. On hover, keep the fill and shift the border to #ffffffe5. Place it inside a #ffffffe5 capsule with 9999px radius and 4px padding, preceded by a "Log in" link in Switzer 20px weight 400 #000000.

2. Build a hero section: the background is a full-bleed painted sky image inside a 1440px container, with a white border and a #117bc8 page background around it. Center a two-line h1 in Signifier weight 300 at 55px, line-height 1.18, letter-spacing 0px, #ffffff. Beneath it, 12px below, add a subline in Switzer 18px weight 400, line-height 1.24, #ffffff. Then, 24px below, add a pill with background #ffffff, text #000000, 9999px radius, padding 8px 15px, Switzer 14px weight 600, and a → arrow. Below the pill, center a device mockup with a 5px solid #dadada bezel, 20px radius and shadow `5px 8px 8px 0px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.25), -4px -6px 8px 0px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.25)`, its bottom third covered by a cloud image fading into #f2f6fc.

3. Build a testimonial card: a div 242px wide with background #ffffff, border-radius 12px, padding 12px 15px, no border, and shadow `0px 4px 10px 0px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.07)`. Add the quote in Switzer 12px weight 500, line-height 1.24, #000000. Then, 8px below, a row with 8px gap holding a 30px avatar at 9999px radius, the name in Switzer 12px weight 700 #000000, and the title in Switzer 12px weight 400 #7d7d7d. Repeat cards in a horizontal row with 8px gaps on a #f2f6fc band.

4. Build a feature story block over the painting: a left column about 255px wide with an h3 in Signifier 34px weight 400, line-height 1.02, #ffffff. Then, 6px below, add body text in Switzer 17px weight 500, line-height 1.2, #ffffff. Then, 20px below, add a glass button with background #00000010, backdrop-filter blur(20px), a 2px solid #ffffff60 border, 9999px radius, padding 12px 38px, height 55px, and the label in Switzer 17px weight 600 #ffffff with a → arrow. Float a white #ffffff list card at the right with 16px radius and shadow `5px 8px 8px -2px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.25), -4px -1px 8px -2px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.2)`.

It sits top-right inside a fixed 124px band that is otherwise transparent, with the stamp logo top-left. ### Testimonial Card
**Role:** Main content card, social proof.

A small white letter. It takes background #ffffff, text #000000, no border, 12px radius, padding 12px 15px, a 242px width, and shadow `0px 4px 10px 0px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.07)`. The quote is set in Switzer 12px weight 500 at a 1.24 line height. Beneath it sit a 9999px avatar, the name in Switzer 12px weight 700 Ink, and the title in Switzer 12px weight 400 #7d7d7d. This shadow is the most-used elevation in the system at 80 instances — the card is quiet paper, and density comes from repetition, not size.

### Testimonial Marquee Band
**Role:** Horizontal scrolling proof strip.

A strip of correspondence. It is a full-width #f2f6fc band directly below the hero's cloudbank, holding a single row of six-plus Testimonial Cards at 8px gaps that scroll horizontally and fade to transparent at both edges. The cards align at the top and run to ragged heights of 92 to 136px. The band reads as the ground the clouds settle onto, the one sustained light zone on a page otherwise painted blue.

### Hero Device Mockup
**Role:** Framed product preview in hero.

A tablet in the clouds. It has a 5px solid #dadada bezel, 20px radius and shadow `5px 8px 8px 0px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.25), -4px -6px 8px 0px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.25)`. It frames "Today's Brief" over its own sky wallpaper, with internal 13px top-corner radii that are mockup-internal. This is the system outlier: its lower third is swallowed by painted cloud, so the frame breaks its own rectangle. That is allowed because the illustration outranks UI chrome.

### Inbox Snippet Card
**Role:** Floating product fragment in features.

A torn-out list. It takes background #ffffff, 16px radius and shadow `5px 8px 8px -2px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.25), -4px -1px 8px -2px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.2)`. Three rows are split by 1px #ebebeb dividers (estimated), each with a checkbox, a 9999px avatar, the sender in Switzer 12px weight 700 Ink, the subject in Switzer 12px weight 500 #2b2b2b, and a right-aligned date. The two-sided shadow is heavier than the cards' 7% — the fragment floats in wind, not on a desk.

### Feature Story Block
**Role:** Left-column narrative per feature.

Prose against paint. The heading is Signifier 34px weight 400 #ffffff at a 1.02 line height. The body is Switzer 17px weight 500 #ffffff, held to roughly 255px wide, followed by the Glass Pill Button 20px below. There is no card, plate or scrim behind the text. The painting itself is composed with an open patch of sky where the copy lands, which is the discipline that replaces a conventional content container.

### Billing Toggle
**Role:** Yearly versus monthly switch.

A two-segment capsule. Each segment has padding 4px 10px and a Switzer 14px weight 600 label. The selected segment renders #000000 on a #ffffff thumb (estimated), and the unselected renders #ffffff on a #00000010 track. The capsule radius is 9999px. It reuses the glass-and-paper pairing of the CTAs, so pricing controls speak the same material language as the buttons.

### FAQ Accordion Row
**Role:** Expandable question list.

A ruled line of text. Each row is 790px wide and 45px tall, with padding 14px 16px, no fill and no radius, and a 1px #ffffff15 bottom border. The question is set in Switzer 17px weight 500 #ffffff (estimated family), with a chevron at the right. The 8% white hairline is the only divider; conventional FAQ rows on white use gray boxes, and here the rule barely interrupts the blue.

### Stamp Logo
**Role:** Brand mark, top-left.

A postage stamp. The lowercase "cora" wordmark in white sits on a sky-blue field inside a perforated white border, about 60px wide, unrounded and unshadowed. It is the only perforated edge in the system. The deliberate outlier anchors the correspondence metaphor — email delivered as a letter.

## Do's and Don'ts

### Do

- Let the painted sky be the canvas and frame it with a #117bc8 margin and a white border — the picture-in-a-frame structure is the thesis.
- Set every headline in Signifier at weight 300 or 400 with 0px tracking, 34px to 55px — quiet serif headlines are what separate Cora from bold-sans AI tools.
- Keep body and card copy in Switzer at 12px weight 500 with a 1.24 line height — small type makes the illustration the loudest element.
- Spend #117bc8 on exactly one filled control, the 9999px trial pill with a 2px #ffffff ring — this rationing is non-negotiable.
- Use #00000010 glass with a 20px blur and a 2px #ffffff60 border for every CTA placed over paint — the edge survives any background tone.
- Lift white cards with `0px 4px 10px 0px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.07)` at 12px radius — the shadow should read as paper resting, not floating.
- Separate sections with 108px of uninterrupted painting — the gap is where the illustration does its storytelling.

### Don't

- Don't set headlines in Switzer at weight 700 — a bold sans at 55px turns the letter into a SaaS banner and erases the serif thesis.
- Don't introduce a second accent such as a green taken from the trees — the budget is one hue, and painted colors are never tokens.
- Don't put #000000 or #7d7d7d text directly on the sky — Ink and Pewter belong on #ffffff, and on blue they fail contrast.
- Don't wrap feature copy in an opaque #ffffff panel — the 34px white serif sitting directly on paint is the composition.
- Don't square the CTAs to 8px radius — every action is a 9999px pill, and corners would read as form fields.
- Don't replace the 1px #ffffff15 FAQ rules with gray boxes — conventional accordion chrome adds plates the sky cannot absorb.
- Don't tighten Signifier with -0.02em tracking at 55px — negative tracking is a tech-display habit that compresses the letterpress spacing.

## Elevation

- **Testimonial cards (80 uses):** `0px 4px 10px 0px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.07)`
- **Small mockup chips and controls:** `0px 5px 4px 0px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.1)`
- **Floating inbox fragments over the sky:** `5px 8px 8px -2px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.25), -4px -1px 8px -2px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.2)`
- **Hero device mockup:** `5px 8px 8px 0px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.25), -4px -6px 8px 0px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.25)`
- **Mockup-internal raised widgets:** `0px 4px 3px -2px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.2), 0px 3px 8px 1px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.12), 0px 5px 5px 1px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.14)`

The rule is real shadows, graded by altitude. Paper on the light band gets 7% black. Objects floating in the sky get 25%, cast in two directions, as if lit by diffuse daylight rather than a single overhead lamp.

## Imagery

Imagery is the system. A single continuous gouache illustration of sky, cumulus banks and ochre-leafed trees runs the full height of the page, 12,207px tall in one image. It is framed by a white border inside the #117bc8 margin, without radius or shadow. Product screenshots never stand alone: they arrive as fragments, either the Hero Device Mockup with a 5px #dadada bezel and 20px radius, or Inbox Snippet Cards at 16px radius, each half-enveloped by painted cloud. Colors inside the mockups are mockup-internal and not system tokens, including the orange date chip (estimated), #cf372d, #0b57d0 and #1d1b20. Icons are minimal arrows and chevrons in white line. There are no gradient orbs or glow tokens, and the only fades are painted. The narrative is a weather report: your inbox drifting away while you look up.

## Layout

Content sits inside a 1440px max-width, with the painting framed edge to edge within it. The hero centers a two-line Signifier 55px headline, an 18px Switzer subline and the paper pill, then the device mockup rising out of clouds into the Mist Band marquee. Feature sections alternate in place rather than in background. Each places a left-column story block about 255px wide against an open patch of sky, with a product fragment floating right, and 108px of painting between stories. Pricing runs three plans in a row, each with a glass "Get Started", and there is no logo row. The FAQ is a single 790px column. The nav is fixed, 124px tall and transparent, with the stamp left and the glass capsule right. The footer is a centered 360px "Free Yourself from Email" CTA block on the painting. At 375px, set display to 34px and section gaps to 65px. Overall density is spacious.

**Example Component Prompts**

1. Build a primary action button: an anchor with background #117bc8, text #ffffff, a 2px solid #ffffff border, border-radius 9999px, padding 8px 23px and height 40px. Set the label "Start free trial" in Switzer at 20px, weight 400, line-height 1.0, letter-spacing 0px, with no shadow. On hover, keep the fill and shift the border to #ffffffe5. Place it inside a #ffffffe5 capsule with 9999px radius and 4px padding, preceded by a "Log in" link in Switzer 20px weight 400 #000000.

2. Build a hero section: the background is a full-bleed painted sky image inside a 1440px container, with a white border and a #117bc8 page background around it. Center a two-line h1 in Signifier weight 300 at 55px, line-height 1.18, letter-spacing 0px, #ffffff. Beneath it, 12px below, add a subline in Switzer 18px weight 400, line-height 1.24, #ffffff. Then, 24px below, add a pill with background #ffffff, text #000000, 9999px radius, padding 8px 15px, Switzer 14px weight 600, and a → arrow. Below the pill, center a device mockup with a 5px solid #dadada bezel, 20px radius and shadow `5px 8px 8px 0px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.25), -4px -6px 8px 0px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.25)`, its bottom third covered by a cloud image fading into #f2f6fc.

3. Build a testimonial card: a div 242px wide with background #ffffff, border-radius 12px, padding 12px 15px, no border, and shadow `0px 4px 10px 0px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.07)`. Add the quote in Switzer 12px weight 500, line-height 1.24, #000000. Then, 8px below, a row with 8px gap holding a 30px avatar at 9999px radius, the name in Switzer 12px weight 700 #000000, and the title in Switzer 12px weight 400 #7d7d7d. Repeat cards in a horizontal row with 8px gaps on a #f2f6fc band.

4. Build a feature story block over the painting: a left column about 255px wide with an h3 in Signifier 34px weight 400, line-height 1.02, #ffffff. Then, 6px below, add body text in Switzer 17px weight 500, line-height 1.2, #ffffff. Then, 20px below, add a glass button with background #00000010, backdrop-filter blur(20px), a 2px solid #ffffff60 border, 9999px radius, padding 12px 38px, height 55px, and the label in Switzer 17px weight 600 #ffffff with a → arrow. Float a white #ffffff list card at the right with 16px radius and shadow `5px 8px 8px -2px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.25), -4px -1px 8px -2px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.2)`.

## Painted Canvas Discipline

The defining rule is that the painting is the background, and every interface element must justify interrupting it. Text sits directly on sky, CTAs are 6% #00000010 glass, and dividers are 8% #ffffff15. Only the testimonial band and product fragments earn opaque #ffffff, and the illustration is composed with open sky precisely where copy lands. Three things would break it: a full-width opaque nav bar, a scrim behind feature text, or a section with a flat colored background. Each turns a framed picture back into a conventional landing page. Extend the system by painting, not by adding fills. A new feature gets a new patch of composed sky, with its fragment half-buried in cloud, and any new control over paint uses the 2px #ffffff60 glass ring. The illustration's palette stays decorative, and keeping it out of the token set is non-negotiable.

## Family-Split Hierarchy

Hierarchy comes from switching families, not from stacking weights. Signifier at 300 and 400 owns every headline from 34px to 55px, while Switzer handles everything at 22px and below, mostly at 12px weight 500. The gap between 22px and 34px is deliberate: no size sits in the middle to blur which voice is speaking. This breaks if someone sets a 28px Switzer bold subtitle, a 20px Signifier label, or a 700-weight serif. Any of these muddies the signal that serif means story and sans means interface. To extend the system, add new headings only on the Signifier steps of 34, 45 and 55px, with 0px tracking. New UI text joins Switzer at an existing size, and weight 700 is reserved for names and emphasis at 12px.

## Similar Brands

- **Cora** — Superhuman: shares the email-category ambition and a serif-leaning, editorial marketing voice, but Superhuman builds on dark gradients where Cora builds on a painted daylight sky.
- **Cora** — Every: the parent publication's serif-headline, letter-like editorial typography carries straight into Cora's Signifier display scale.
- **Cora** — The Browser Company (Arc): uses hand-made illustration as the brand surface and frosted controls over it, though Arc spends more chromatic hues.
- **Cora** — Shortwave: a direct AI-email competitor that floats inbox fragments as product proof, but on a conventional white canvas with sans headlines.
- **Cora** — Headspace: illustration-first storytelling with soft rounded white cards, though Headspace uses a multi-hue palette where Cora rations one.
